items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: Horowitz wrote something about ART years ago... Horowitz used to love to hear ART play.

ctx.x: listened to the French Impressionists. And it doesn't swing, you know.

Well, everybody's leaving the basics and going for the classics mostly, you know. And classics is one thing and jazz is something else, you know. I don't think anyone was equipped to play classics more than Art Tatum. Oh, my goodness, what a -- he had everything going for him, left-hand, in fact, Horowitz wrote something about ART years ago, that he wished he had his technique on piano, with both hands. And, you know, Horowitz used to love to hear ART play.
